method:
Can the KORAIL 1F tender underlay place the public / back-of-house boundary of the 1F within ~1 u? (-> 1f-underlay-fit.json)

Underlay: asset-library/research-public/2026-09-24/metric-controls/korail-1f-underlay-readable.png (960x572, <= 2025, the
same raster under the 2025-05 / 2025-08 / 2026-01 tender location plans). Drawing axes: x -> U-, y -> plaza (V-).
Controls (drawing px picked on zoomed crops <-> source-shell section at Y 1.0 of geometry-after11): the two plaza-side
entry alcoves beside cores A/B (4 corners each) and the two corners of the U- end wall. Affine least squares (the raster
is anisotropic: ~.174 u/px along x, ~.150 u/px along y).
Hold-outs: the track-side shell wall along the drawing's top line, the GATE3/4 doors vs the class-a portals, the observed
rear-row frontage (tier b), and the class-a registered central escalator bank (escalator-core.json).
